extDescription.message: Speeds up working with logs in Kibana Discover: action buttons built from log fields.

errorForbidden.message: kibanatool: you are not allowed to read this log

errorIncompatible.message: kibanatool: possibly incompatible with this Kibana version ($VERSION$)

optionsIntro.message: Add the Kibana addresses you use, grant access, then define link actions. Reload open Kibana tabs after changes.

optionsLoadError.message: The stored settings are invalid, so empty settings are in use. Saving anything replaces the stored settings:

optionsSavedReload.message: Saved. Reload open Kibana tabs to apply.

optionsActionsHelp.message: Buttons shown above an open log. Placeholders: {field} or {field|fallback}; a placeholder without a value hides the button.

discoverNoTime.message: No time to center on: the data view has no time field or this log has no value for it

noticeTimeNotConverted.message: Could not convert the time range to fixed dates

optionsPermissionError.message: Chrome could not update the access permission: $ERROR$

optionsMarkdownFieldsHelp.message: One field per line. Empty: every field, alphabetically.

optionsMaskPatternsLine.message: One pattern per line. * matches anything; case does not matter.

optionsMaskPatternsHelp.message: A field or element whose name matches is masked with everything inside it, keys inside JSON, XML and form text included. To keep a wrapper such as GetTokenRequest readable, narrow the pattern instead of removing it: *token (names that end in "token") in place of *token*. Avoid *.token: it masks only names that are exactly "token", so tokens such as platform-token stay readable.

optionsValueMasksHelp.message: Searched inside every value, whatever the field's name. Applies to every copy: Markdown, JSON and cURL.

optionsExportHelp.message: Saves environments, variables, actions, and copy and masking settings as one JSON file.

optionsImportPreview.message: This file has $ENVIRONMENTS$ environments and $ACTIONS$ actions. Importing replaces all current settings; grant access to the environments afterwards.

optionsEmptyActions.message: No actions yet. Add a link or Discover action to get started.

optionsUrlTemplate.message: URL template: {field} comes from the log, {env.name} from the environment, e.g. {env.adminUrl}/users/{user_id}

optionsQueryTemplate.message: KQL query template; values are quoted for you, e.g. user_id:{user_id}

optionsWindowMinutes.message: Minutes before and after the log's time (empty: keep the current time range)

optionsPreviewSample.message: Sample log as JSON (a raw hit or its _source)

optionsPreviewInvalid.message: The sample is not a JSON object: $ERROR$

optionsHiddenConditions.message: Hidden: a condition does not hold for this log

optionsHiddenMissingValue.message: Hidden: a placeholder has no value in this log

optionsHiddenInvalidUrl.message: Hidden: the result is not a valid http(s) URL

passiveMissingVariable.message: $NAME$ is not set for the $ENV$ environment

passiveInvalidVariable.message: $NAME$ is not an http(s) address in the $ENV$ environment

passiveDataViewNotFound.message: No data view named "$NAME$" in this space

passiveDataViewLookupFailed.message: Could not read the data view list

optionsVariablesHelp.message: Use them in templates as {env.name}. Each environment has its own value; an empty cell means the variable is not set there. Rows without a value are not saved.

optionsTargetDataView.message: Target data view (empty: the data view of the open log)
